notes.title: 🔔 If you are interested - pay attention to us!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, everyone![/b]
This isn’t a big update — more like a small wave to anyone passing by 👋[/h3][p]We’re already testing our game on Steam. Every day, we break things, fix things, add new stuff, and check old features. Just today, we tested P2P connectivity via Steam_Lobby. Yep, the game already connects through Steam and we’re steadily progressing![/p][p]This post is less about patch notes — more of a signal:
[b]If our game interests you, please wishlist it on Steam![/b] 💙
It really helps, especially before release.
And hey — if you tell your friends, or even make a TikTok with the hashtag #RustRides, we’d be thrilled.[/p][p]We truly believe our project deserves your attention. We’re putting both heart and tech brain 🧠 into this.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ A quick look at the technical side:[/h3][list][*][p]Solid [b]optimization[/b], even for weaker PCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Have an older GPU? We’re adding [b]AI frame generation[/b] for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Have RTX? Enjoy [b]full ray tracing support[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Don’t have RTX? No worries — it’ll still look great.[/p][/*][*][p]Our settings are flexible, adaptive, and designed for comfort.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]💬 Thanks for reading!
Be patient just a bit longer — we’ll deliver a [b]cool, stable, and stylish game[/b] just for you.[/p][p]With love,
The [i]Rust Rides[/i] Dev Team[/p]
